name: Real-Time Journey Orchestration & NBA
description: Plane 3 of the CXOS Journey Triad — real-time, interventionist decision engine governing what IS happening right now and what SHOULD happen next: live conformance-drift interception between Plane 1 blueprints and Plane 2 telemetry, Next-Best-Action (NBA) and Next-Best-Experience (NBX) arbitration, wait-aware dynamic channel steering, orchestrated A2A specialist delegation, omnichannel context hydration, and cross-channel suppression governance.
roleInCenter: Real-time interventionist brain: continuously compares the live customer state (Plane 2) against the normative blueprint (Plane 1) and executes the single best action, channel switch, A2A specialist delegation, or suppression gate to steer the journey to resolution.

glossary.definition: Persistent real-time state graph tracking a customer's active blueprint stage, open issues, prior channel touches, and pending commitments across sessions
Streaming business or telemetry event such as a failed payment, shipment delay, or repeated app error that initiates or transitions a live journey state
Real-time decisioning matrix that ranks competing retention, service recovery, protocol, and sales actions by customer value, urgency, confidence band, and eligibility
Governance control that halts marketing or automated outbound campaigns when an active service escalation, dispute, or recent inbound resolution exists
Timely push notification, SMS, or in-app card dispatched ahead of a predicted inbound call to resolve an issue or confirm status along the Plane 1 proactive path
Rolling window ceiling limiting total proactive notifications and outbound touches across all channels per customer
Shared context payload linking a digital web failure or mobile app flow directly to an inbound voice or chat session within the same journey
Automated orchestration step that follows up on high-value cart, application, or queue abandons via preferred asynchronous channel within the SLA recovery window

Runtime guard that compares a customer's live Plane 2 trace against their Plane 1 Golden Path blueprint and triggers immediate corrective intervention when stage SLA budgets, loop thresholds, or sentiment floors are breached

Multi-step orchestration policy that selects not just a single isolated offer (NBA) but the optimal downstream sequence of channel modality, agent skill, empathy posture, and follow-up cadence to restore the Golden Path

Real-time deflection and modality-switching control that inspects live ACD queue wait telemetry and WFM capacity before steering a customer between voice, asynchronous messaging, visual web cards, or scheduled callback

Plane 3 invocation that dispatches a bounded sub-task with a signed context envelope to a specialist AI agent over the A2A protocol and merges the verified artifact back into the live customer journey

Sub-second assembly and injection of the canonical omnichannel context envelope (intent stack, verified auth level, extracted slots, A2A provenance, and Plane 2 drift status) into ACD SIP headers and agent co-pilot desktops at the moment of handoff

Sub-10ms calibrated confidence gate evaluating proposal reliability into high (act immediately), medium (act with customer or supervisor verification), or low (gather more context or escalate) execution bands

facets.name: Journey Event Triggers & State Management
facets.description: Streaming signals and persistent state transitions that drive real-time journey progression across channels

children.name: Service or Fulfillment Exception
children.description: Order delay, outage impact, or appointment reschedule event

children.name: Billing Shock or Declined Payment
children.description: Unusual bill spike or renewal failure likely to drive an inbound contact

children.name: Digital Friction & Rage-Click Signal
children.description: Repeated form errors, failed login attempts, or help-page looping in web or app

children.name: Onboarding & First-Value Stage
children.description: Guided setup and early adoption milestones

children.name: Active Case & Recovery Stage
children.description: Open support ticket or SLA breach recovery state

children.name: Churn Risk & Retention Stage
children.description: Contract maturity or downgrade signal requiring retention arbitration

facets.name: Next-Best-Action Arbitration & Policy
facets.description: Scoring and prioritization logic selecting the single best action and trajectory for a live customer moment

children.name: Regulatory, Fraud & Safety Override
children.description: Mandatory security verification or regulatory disclosure preempts all other actions

children.name: Urgent Service Recovery & SLA Save
children.description: Proactive apology, fee credit, or priority routing when service failure or conformance drift occurred

children.name: Churn Prevention & Retention Offer
children.description: Targeted loyalty intervention for high-LTV customers exhibiting churn signals

children.name: Contextual Cross-Sell & Onboarding
children.description: Eligible plan optimization or feature adoption offer only when sentiment is positive and primary intent is resolved

children.name: Live Agent Co-Pilot NBA Card
children.description: Surfaces arbitrated action directly inside an active voice or chat handling session

children.name: Proactive SMS or In-App Notification
children.description: Low-friction digital nudge honoring customer channel preference and quiet hours

children.name: Wait-Aware Modality Pivot
children.description: Dynamically offers visual messaging or scheduled callback when voice queue EWT exceeds the Plane 1 stage SLA budget

facets.name: Channel Suppression & Contact Governance
facets.description: Guardrails preventing conflicting messages, over-contacting, and tone-deaf outreach across autonomous and human channels

children.name: Open Escalation Promotional Mute
children.description: Suppresses all sales and marketing outreach while an unresolved complaint or high-priority ticket is open

children.name: Post-Contact Outbound Cooldown
children.description: Cancels scheduled outbound reminders if the customer resolved the issue inbound minutes earlier

children.name: Multi-Channel Alert Deduplication
children.description: Ensures a single disruption event sends one preferred notification rather than simultaneous email, SMS, and voice blasts

facets.name: Real-Time Conformance Drift & A2A Interventions
facets.description: Active Plane 3 closed-loop controls that intercept Plane 2 drift from Plane 1 blueprints, delegate tasks to A2A specialist agents, rescue omnichannel context, and gate execution by calibrated confidence

children.name: Real-Time Blueprint Drift Interception
children.description: In-flight remedies triggered when a live customer trace diverges from its Plane 1 Golden Path

children.name: Bot & IVR Loop-Breaker Save
children.description: Intercepts a customer on their second consecutive self-service loop and fast-tracks to a priority specialist queue

children.name: Stage SLA Breach Priority Boost
children.description: Dynamically elevates ACD queue priority or triggers instant callback offer when cumulative journey wait approaches the Plane 1 ceiling

children.name: Repeat-Relapse Concierge Routing
children.description: Detects a 7-day repeat contact at arrival and routes directly to a tier-2 resolution owner rather than standard tier-1 triage

children.name: Dynamic A2A Delegation & Context Rescue
children.description: Coordinating specialist AI agents and preserving full omnichannel state across modality and actor boundaries

children.name: Dynamic A2A Specialist Sub-Task Dispatch
children.description: Delegates domain-specific work (such as billing ledger audit or order reshipment) to an A2A specialist agent while maintaining customer dialog

children.name: Omnichannel Context Rescue & Hydration
children.description: Reconstructs and injects dropped web or bot session slots into the agent desktop and SIP UUI envelope prior to call answer

children.name: Confidence-Banded Human-in-the-Loop Escalation
children.description: Applies Strands System-One confidence bands so high-confidence actions execute autonomously, medium verify with the customer, and low escalate warmly with full provenance

metrics.name: Proactive Nudge Inbound Deflection Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of customers receiving a proactive status or resolution nudge who do not initiate a predicted inbound contact within 48 hours

metrics.name: NBA-Attributed Contact Value
metrics.definition: Average retained or incremental customer value realized per interaction where the arbitrated Next-Best-Action or Next-Best-Experience was executed

metrics.name: End-to-End Journey Resolution Rate
metrics.definition: Share of multi-step customer journeys steered to full resolution on the first assisted or automated episode without channel-hopping repeats

metrics.name: Live Conformance Drift SLA Save Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of in-flight journeys flagged for impending stage SLA breach or self-service looping that are recovered within the normative blueprint SLA budget via Plane 3 intervention

metrics.name: Context-Hydrated Escalation Handle Time
metrics.definition: Average live agent handle time on escalated journeys where Plane 3 injected the full omnichannel and A2A context envelope prior to answer

metrics.name: High-Priority Journey Escalation Intercepts
metrics.definition: Count of critical at-risk customer journeys requiring emergency high-priority queue intervention after unmitigated drift

metrics.name: Cross-Channel Journey CSAT
metrics.definition: Customer satisfaction score on interactions where prior digital, A2A, or proactive journey state was preserved and orchestrated into handling

scoringModel.name: Real-Time Journey Orchestration & Intervention Precision Scorecard
scoringModel.note: Evaluates Plane 3 runtime orchestration quality across conformance drift saves, NBA priority hierarchy discipline, omnichannel context hydration, and confidence-gated A2A delegation.

dimensions.name: Live Conformance Drift Interception
dimensions.description: Speed and accuracy in detecting Plane 2 divergence from Plane 1 blueprints and executing loop-breaker or SLA-save interventions
sampleCriteria: Intercepts bot or IVR containment loops within 2 failed turns
Applies dynamic queue priority boosts when cumulative journey wait nears Plane 1 ceiling
Routes 7-day repeat-relapse arrivals directly to specialist recovery queues

dimensions.name: NBA Priority Hierarchy & Sentiment Discipline
dimensions.description: Strict enforcement of safety, compliance, and service-recovery overrides ahead of commercial or retention offers
sampleCriteria: Preempts all commercial offers when open tickets, billing disputes, or negative sentiment exist
Matches action urgency and tone to live customer sentiment trajectory
Selects wait-aware channel steering aligned with real-time WFM and ACD capacity

dimensions.name: Omnichannel & A2A Context Envelope Hydration
dimensions.description: Zero-loss propagation of identity, intent stack, extracted slots, and A2A specialist outputs across channel switches and agent handoffs
sampleCriteria: Hydrates canonical context envelope into ACD SIP headers and agent co-pilot before call answer
Delegates bounded sub-tasks to A2A specialist agents with full provenance tracking
Eliminates customer re-authentication and slot repetition across modality switches

dimensions.name: Suppression Ledger & Contact Fatigue Governance
dimensions.description: Prevention of redundant, stale, or over-frequent proactive and outbound notifications across channels
sampleCriteria: Performs sub-second CRM and ACD resolution check immediately before message dispatch
Enforces hard rolling daily and weekly contact fatigue caps across all campaigns
Deduplicates multi-channel alerts to the customer's single preferred modality

dimensions.name: Calibrated Confidence-Band Execution
dimensions.description: Adherence to System-One confidence thresholds governing autonomous execution versus verification or human escalation
sampleCriteria: Executes autonomously only when calibrated confidence meets the high band threshold (0.70+)
Triggers explicit verification or disambiguation in the medium confidence band (0.40 to 0.69)
Escalates low-confidence (<0.40) or out-of-policy cases to human specialists with structured context

failureModes.name: Tone-Deaf Upsell During Service Failure
failureModes.signal: Angry customers receive promotional NBA offers during outage or billing-dispute calls; CSAT drops and complaints spike
failureModes.mitigation: Enforce real-time sentiment and open-incident suppression gates that zero commercial NBA weights when frustration or active tickets exist

failureModes.name: Delayed Event Nudge After Resolution
failureModes.signal: Customers receive proactive 'issue detected' SMS hours after already calling in and resolving the problem, triggering confused repeat calls
failureModes.mitigation: Enforce sub-second CRM, ACD, and Plane 2 trace disposition checks immediately prior to message dispatch

failureModes.name: Web-to-Voice Journey Amnesia
failureModes.signal: Customer clicks 'Call Support' inside an authenticated app error flow but lands in generic IVR root menu with no context
failureModes.mitigation: Inject canonical omnichannel continuity tokens bindable by ANI or session code to fast-track IVR and hydrate ACD and desktop co-pilot state

failureModes.name: Siloed Campaign Fatigue Cap Bypass
failureModes.signal: Opt-out rates and spam complaints climb because billing, collections, and marketing triggers fire independently on the same day
failureModes.mitigation: Centralize all outbound and proactive triggers through a unified journey suppression ledger with hard daily and weekly caps

failureModes.name: Blueprint-Blind Local Stage Optimization
failureModes.signal: Orchestrator aggressively deflects high-emotion Moment-of-Truth contacts to low-cost chat to save immediate voice queue wait, causing severe downstream repeat contacts and churn
failureModes.mitigation: Bind Plane 3 channel steering to Plane 1 Moment-of-Truth contracts and Plane 2 true 7-day journey FCR outcomes

failureModes.name: Unbounded A2A Specialist Delegation Loop
failureModes.signal: Orchestrator and specialist AI agents pass an ambiguous customer request back and forth across multiple A2A hops, spiking turn latency and token cost without resolution
failureModes.mitigation: Enforce strict hop-count TTL budgets in the context envelope and trigger confidence-banded warm human escalation when confidence remains below 0.70
